chunks: "So go early to your plantation, if you want to gather the fruits."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'In kuntum sarimin' in Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Qalam (68:17), God addresses the people of the village who resolved to harvest their crops early in the morning (ghadw) to avoid the poor who had been cutting them at night. This narrative, often linked to the story of the People of the Village (Ahl al-Qarya) or specific companions in Shia exegesis, illustrates the human tendency to rely on strategic timing and effort while forgetting divine decree. It serves as a precursor to the divine response where their plans were thwarted, emphasizing the theme of 'waiting' (tannu) for God's command.
